about: T2 walk graph, generated by pipeline/scripts/terminal_export.py from the sim's navigation graph (t2_nav.json) and zones.json. Re-exported when the interior moves; ids stay. D7, D26.
origin: Unity world frame in metres: x east, y = Unity z = north. Same numbers as zones.json / points.json; level G (floor at 192.21 m), U (floor at 198.16 m), X (outside).
walkSecNote: Shortest walk on the sim's graph between the two ends at free flow; apply A8 on top. inferred = straight line (outside the terminal) or the two zones' walk nodes are not connected on their own. evacuationOnly = crosses landside/airside without passing U_SECURITY, or uses the gate stairs and doors to the outside.

check_in:1.note: desks of a group staff only while a flight it serves has its desk window open

nodes.note: alias of check_in:FR: Unity has three physical groups
